    print(f"{y} | {gov_rates[i]:.8f} | {public_rates[i]:.8f}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
def pop_std(values):
    n = len(values)
    mean = sum(values) / n
    variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / n
    return math.sqrt(variance)

def mean(values):
    return sum(values) / len(values)

# Calculate coefficient of variation (CV = std / mean)
gov_mean = mean(gov_rates)
gov_std = pop_std(gov_rates)
gov_cv = gov_std / gov_mean

public_mean = mean(public_rates)
public_std = pop_std(public_rates)
public_cv = public_std / public_mean

print(f"\nGovernment Accounts:")
print(f"  Mean of log growth rates: {gov_mean:.8f}")
print(f"  Population Std Dev: {gov_std:.8f}")
print(f"  Coefficient of Variation: {gov_cv:.8f}")

print(f"\nPublic Held:")
print(f"  Mean of log growth rates: {public_mean:.8f}")
print(f"  Population Std Dev: {public_std:.8f}")
print(f"  Coefficient of Variation: {public_cv:.8f}")

# Absolute difference
abs_diff = abs(gov_cv - public_cv)
print(f"\nAbsolute Difference: {abs_diff:.8f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest thousandth: {round(abs_diff, 3)}")
EOF
